title.zh-CN: 抬头不稳、不会独坐 · 11月龄男婴
title.en: Unsteady head control and not yet sitting · 11-month-old boy

summary.zh-CN: 11个月大的男孩还抬头不稳、不会自己坐，婴儿期做过眼睛手术，这次住进儿科病房查找发育落后的原因。
summary.en: An 11-month-old boy still cannot hold his head steady or sit on his own; he had eye surgery in infancy and is admitted to the children's ward to find out why his development is behind.

notes.zh-CN: 依据一篇已发表的单例报告改写。患者事实沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容：年龄、性别、体重；11个月抬头不稳、不能独坐，8个月不会翻身；3个月眼睛不追光物，诊断先天性白内障和青光眼并手术；第二胎第二产、41周顺产、无窒息产伤抢救史；10岁哥哥健康；查体（反应迟钝、不能扶站和抓握交换物体、四肢松弛低张力、腱反射未引出、左瞳孔外侧少许白斑、双瞳孔上方裂缝样术后所见）；血气、血红蛋白、尿液检查、SMN1、脑电图、听觉诱发电位和基因检测（含母亲外周血）结果；尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、日历日期和身份细节已去除。陪同家属的具体身份、对话、阶段、决策、处置选项、评分、教学要点和医护人物是教学设计；没有记录的内容（生命体征、电解质、血磷、血钙、肌酐、白蛋白、红细胞指数、眼压和视力、新生儿期、治疗和随访）保持未知。保留的不一致：尿比重记为“1.0”，不是有效读数，按原样保留并注明需核对；血红蛋白是在血常规还是血气仪上测得没有说明；1.0.0版记录了8.7 kg的体重，但没有说明何时称重，而其导师指南又说没有重建体重。
notes.en: Adapted from one published case report. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0: age, sex and weight; unsteady head control and inability to sit at 11 months, not rolling at 8 months; not following light or objects at 3 months, with congenital cataracts and glaucoma diagnosed and operated on; second pregnancy and birth, vaginal delivery at 41 weeks without asphyxia, birth injury or resuscitation; a healthy brother aged ten; the examination (slow responses, unable to stand with support or grasp and transfer objects, lax hypotonic limbs, unelicitable tendon reflexes, a small white patch lateral to the left pupil, slit-like post-operative appearance above both pupils); the blood gas, haemoglobin, urine tests, SMN1, EEG, auditory evoked potentials and the genetic test, including the mother's blood. They have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed. Which relative accompanies him, the dialogue, phases, decisions, management options, scoring, teaching points and staff are teaching design; what the case does not record (vital signs, electrolytes, phosphate, calcium, creatinine, albumin, red-cell indices, eye pressures and vision, the newborn period, treatment and follow-up) stays unknown. Inconsistencies kept: the urine specific gravity is recorded as “1.0”, which is not a valid reading — kept as recorded and flagged for checking; whether the haemoglobin came from a blood count or the blood-gas analyser is not stated; 1.0.0 records a weight of 8.7 kg without saying when it was measured, while its guide says weights were not reconstructed.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在先天性白内障和青光眼术后、低张力伴腱反射消失的婴儿中，想到累及眼、脑、肾的多系统疾病，按整体表型选择检查（AAP 2025），在送SMN1检测（2018年国际脊髓性肌萎缩诊疗共识）的同时检查血气、电解质和尿液。
learningOutcomes.en: In an infant with operated congenital cataract and glaucoma, hypotonia and absent reflexes, think of a multisystem eye–brain–kidney disorder and, choosing tests from the whole phenotype (AAP 2025), check the blood gas, electrolytes and urine alongside SMN1 testing (international SMA care consensus, 2018).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把血液酸中毒时尿pH 7.0判读为肾小管性酸中毒，用尿β2微球蛋白 > 500 µg/L和广泛性氨基酸尿把它定位在近端小管（肾性范科尼型表现），并与远端肾小管酸中毒、胱氨酸病以及IPNA 2022所定义的肾病综合征相鉴别——0.86 g/24 h的尿蛋白而没有白蛋白记录，不足以诊断肾病综合征。
learningOutcomes.en: Read a urine pH of 7.0 during acidaemia as a renal tubular acidosis, place it in the proximal tubule from urine β2-microglobulin above 500 µg/L and generalised aminoaciduria (a renal Fanconi-type picture), and tell it from distal RTA, cystinosis and — 0.86 g/24 h of protein with no albumin recorded — nephrotic syndrome as IPNA 2022 defines it.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 先测钾、磷、钙和肌酐，再用全天分次口服的枸橼酸盐或碳酸氢钠（这个月龄可随喂奶少量给）按血碳酸氢根逐步纠正慢性酸中毒，并按结果补钾、补磷和骨化三醇（GeneReviews：Lowe综合征，2019；ERKNet/ESPN 2021远端肾小管酸中毒的原则）；不静脉推注碳酸氢钠，也不对肾小管性蛋白尿用激素。
learningOutcomes.en: Measure potassium, phosphate, calcium and creatinine, then correct the chronic acidosis gradually with oral citrate or bicarbonate divided through the day (with feeds at his age), titrated to the serum bicarbonate, adding potassium, phosphate and calcitriol as the results require (GeneReviews: Lowe syndrome, 2019; the ERKNet/ESPN 2021 principles for distal RTA) — with no IV bicarbonate bolus and no steroids for tubular proteinuria.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按ACMG/AMP 2015判读OCRL（旧称OCRL1）的无义变异，说明母亲外周血阴性仍不能排除生殖腺嵌合，并提供遗传咨询、母亲裂隙灯晶状体检查和再次怀孕时的产前或胚胎植入前检测。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret a nonsense variant in OCRL (legacy name OCRL1) under ACMG/AMP 2015, explain that a negative maternal blood test does not exclude germline mosaicism, and offer counselling, a maternal slit-lamp lens examination and prenatal or pre-implantation testing in a future pregnancy.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 制订终身的多学科随访：眼压和视功能、按JCIH 2019尽快做诊断性听力评估并助听、肾小管、骨骼和肾功能监测以及早期干预；并为70 g/L的血红蛋白另找原因。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan lifelong multidisciplinary follow-up — eye pressure and vision, a prompt diagnostic hearing assessment with amplification (JCIH 2019), tubular, bone and kidney-function monitoring and early intervention — and look for a separate cause of the haemoglobin of 70 g/L.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge的结构向家属解释诊断、治疗、遗传方式和其中的不确定性，用SPIKES告知基因诊断这一坏消息，并用回授法确认理解。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain the diagnosis, the treatment, the inheritance and its uncertainties to the family in a Calgary–Cambridge structure, breaking the genetic diagnosis as bad news with SPIKES and checking understanding by teach-back.

triageNote.zh-CN: 11月龄男婴，因运动发育落后收入儿科病房：至今抬头不稳，不能独坐。婴儿期做过眼部手术。家属陪同。
triageNote.en: Boy aged 11 months, admitted to the paediatric ward with delayed motor development: his head control is still unsteady and he cannot sit unsupported. He had eye surgery earlier in infancy. A relative is with him.

personality.zh-CN: 11个月大的男婴，因运动发育落后住进儿科病房，还不会说话。
personality.en: An 11-month-old boy admitted to the children's ward because his motor development is behind; he cannot talk yet.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 不会说话；陪同的家属用日常口语回答所有问题，不用医学术语，不清楚的就直说不清楚。
speechStyle.en: He does not talk; the relative with him answers every question in everyday words, without medical terms, and says plainly when they don't know.

openingLine.zh-CN: （他11个月大，躺在病床上；家属守在床边，说孩子到现在还抬头不稳，自己坐不住。）
openingLine.en: (He is eleven months old and lying in his cot; his relative, at his side, says he still can't hold his head steady or sit up by himself.)

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：孩子不会说话，所有问题由家属回答。家属担心、着急，想弄明白孩子为什么比别的孩子慢这么多；只讲自己知道或听医生说过的事，不知道的直说不知道，不编造；检查结果和诊断留给医生说。基因结果出来以后，家属更关心是不是家里遗传的、以后再要孩子会不会这样、哥哥有没有事。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: the baby does not talk, so the relative answers everything. The relative is worried and wants to understand why he is so far behind other babies; says only what they know or have heard from the doctors, admits what they don't know and never invents; leaves results and the diagnosis to the doctors. Once the genetic result is back, the relative's questions turn to whether it runs in the family, whether a future baby could have it, and whether his brother is all right.

name.zh-CN: 魏知远的家属（化名）

persona.zh-CN: 陪孩子住院的近亲属；是哪位亲属不清楚，不要另加设定。着急但配合，用日常口语回答，只讲自己知道或听医生说过的事；记不清就直说，不替医生下结论。
persona.en: A close relative staying with him in hospital; which relative is not known, so add nothing. Anxious but cooperative; answers in everyday words, saying only what they know or have heard from the doctors; says so when they can't remember and draws no medical conclusions.

nonVerbalReason.en: an infant, too young to speak

description.zh-CN: 他因为运动发育落后住进儿科病房。向陪同的家属了解病史，给他查体，然后决定先送哪些检查。
description.en: He has been admitted to the children's ward because his motor development is behind. Take the history from his relative, examine him, then decide which tests to send first.

description.en: The genetic test report is back, together with the result of his mother's blood test. Interpret it, talk with the family about what it means and the risk for future children, and plan his long-term follow-up.

name.zh-CN: 口服碱剂（枸橼酸盐或碳酸氢钠）

dose.zh-CN: 口服枸橼酸钠/枸橼酸钾合剂或碳酸氢钠，每日分3–4次；知道血钾后开始，按复查的血碳酸氢根逐步加量至正常范围。近端肾小管丢失碳酸氢根，所需剂量常是远端肾小管酸中毒的数倍，由儿童肾脏科确定；是否用含钾制剂取决于实测血钾。
dose.en: Oral sodium/potassium citrate or sodium bicarbonate in 3–4 divided doses a day, started once the potassium is known and increased against repeat serum bicarbonate until it is in the normal range. Proximal bicarbonate wasting often needs several times the dose of distal RTA, set by paediatric nephrology; whether to use a potassium salt depends on the measured potassium.

response.zh-CN: 已开始口服碱剂，之后按复查的血气和电解质调整剂量。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Oral alkali started, to be adjusted against repeat blood gases and electrolytes. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉推注碳酸氢钠纠正碱缺失
name.en: IV sodium bicarbonate bolus to correct the base deficit

dose.zh-CN: 碳酸氢钠静脉给予，所需mmol数按“碱缺失（mmol/L）× 体重（kg）× 0.3”计算。
dose.en: Sodium bicarbonate IV, the amount in mmol calculated as base deficit (mmol/L) × weight (kg) × 0.3.

harm.zh-CN: 既不需要，也不安全。pH 7.271的慢性肾小管性酸中毒应口服碱剂逐步纠正（与ERKNet/ESPN 2021远端肾小管酸中毒临床实践要点的原则一致）；近端小管的碳酸氢根阈值降低，静脉补进去的碳酸氢根很快从尿中丢失。他的血钾和血钙都还不知道：范科尼型肾小管病常丢钾，快速碱化会把钾推进细胞、降低离子钙——对一个本来就肌张力低的婴儿，可诱发危险的低钾（心律失常、呼吸肌更无力）和低钙抽搐，还带来钠负荷。
harm.en: Neither needed nor safe. A chronic tubular acidosis at pH 7.271 is corrected gradually with oral alkali (the approach of the ERKNet/ESPN 2021 clinical practice points for distal RTA), and with a lowered proximal threshold infused bicarbonate is soon lost in the urine. His potassium and calcium are not known: Fanconi-type tubulopathies often waste potassium, and rapid alkalinisation drives potassium into cells and lowers ionised calcium — in an already floppy infant this can precipitate dangerous hypokalaemia (arrhythmia, weaker breathing muscles) and hypocalcaemic tetany, besides a sodium load.

response.zh-CN: 已静脉给予碳酸氢钠。本病例没有记录用过碳酸氢钠；不模拟其后果。
response.en: IV sodium bicarbonate given. This case does not record any bicarbonate infusion; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 口服磷酸盐和骨化三醇

dose.zh-CN: 只在测得低血磷或有佝偻病证据时使用：口服中性磷酸盐分次给予，加骨化三醇；剂量由儿童肾脏科按血磷、碱性磷酸酶和甲状旁腺激素调整。
dose.en: Only for a measured low phosphate or evidence of rickets: oral neutral phosphate in divided doses with calcitriol, dosed by paediatric nephrology against phosphate, alkaline phosphatase and PTH.

response.zh-CN: 已开具磷酸盐和骨化三醇。他的血磷、碱性磷酸酶和甲状旁腺激素都没有记录，无法判断是否需要；本病例没有记录是否做过这一步，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Phosphate and calcitriol prescribed. His phosphate, alkaline phosphatase and PTH are not recorded, so whether he needs them cannot be judged; this case does not record whether this was done and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 请儿童肾脏科会诊
name.en: Ask paediatric nephrology to see him

dose.zh-CN: 当天请儿童肾脏科会诊，确定碱剂、补钾补磷和维生素D的方案以及复查频率。
dose.en: Same-day paediatric nephrology review to set the alkali, potassium, phosphate and vitamin D plan and how often to recheck.

response.zh-CN: 儿童肾脏科医生已知情，会来看他。本病例没有记录会诊经过；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The paediatric nephrology team has been told and will see him. This case does not record a consultation; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 检测前遗传咨询、知情同意并送检候选基因
name.en: Pre-test counselling and consent, then send the candidate-gene test

dose.zh-CN: 向家属说明检测目的、可能的结果和对家人的意义，取得书面同意；按表型为他送检与眼、脑、肾表现相符的候选基因，或包含该基因的基因包、外显子组（AAP 2025临床报告），再按结果需要检测父母。
dose.en: Explain to the family what the test is for, what it may show and what it can mean for relatives, and take written consent; choosing from his phenotype, send the candidate gene that fits his eye, brain and kidney findings, or a panel or exome that includes it (AAP 2025 clinical report), then test the parents as the result requires.

response.zh-CN: 已做检测前咨询并取得同意，标本已送检，结果在“基因检测回报”阶段回来。本病例记录了这次基因检测及其结果，但没有记录是否做过检测前咨询；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The family has been counselled and has consented, and the sample has been sent; the result comes back in the genetic-report phase. This case records the genetic test and its result but not whether pre-test counselling was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 检测后遗传咨询：向父母解释结果和再发风险
name.en: Post-test genetic counselling: explain the result and the recurrence risk to the parents

dose.zh-CN: 由临床遗传科医生和主管医生与父母面谈：检测结果和遗传方式、再发风险及其不确定性、哪些亲属需要检测，以及再次怀孕时的选择；会后给书面总结。
dose.en: A meeting of the clinical geneticist and his doctor with the parents: the result and how it is inherited, the recurrence risk and its uncertainty, which relatives should be offered testing, and the options in a future pregnancy; a written summary afterwards.

response.zh-CN: 已安排遗传咨询面谈。本病例没有记录遗传咨询的经过；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The counselling meeting is arranged. This case does not record any genetic counselling; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 儿童眼科随访：眼压、屈光矫正和弱视治疗
name.en: Paediatric ophthalmology follow-up: eye pressure, optical correction and amblyopia care

dose.zh-CN: 转儿童眼科：测眼压（必要时镇静或麻醉下），评估术眼的屈光矫正、弱视和视功能，终身定期复查。
dose.en: Refer to paediatric ophthalmology: intraocular pressure (under sedation or anaesthesia if needed), optical correction of the operated eyes, amblyopia and visual function, with lifelong regular review.

response.zh-CN: 儿童眼科会接诊并安排随访。本病例没有记录眼科随访的情况；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Paediatric ophthalmology will see him and arrange follow-up. This case does not record any eye follow-up; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 转听力学：诊断性听力评估和助听干预
name.en: Refer to audiology: diagnostic hearing assessment and amplification

dose.zh-CN: 尽快做诊断性听力评估（频率特异性ABR、声导抗、耳声发射，能配合时做行为测听）；确认听力损失后尽早验配助听器，并转早期干预。
dose.en: A diagnostic hearing assessment without delay (frequency-specific ABR, tympanometry, otoacoustic emissions and behavioural audiometry as he can manage); hearing aids and early intervention as soon as a loss is confirmed.

response.zh-CN: 听力学会安排诊断性评估。本病例没有记录后续的听力评估或干预；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Audiology will carry out the diagnostic assessment. This case does not record any further hearing assessment or treatment; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 转早期干预与康复：物理治疗、作业治疗和发育随访
name.en: Refer to early intervention: physiotherapy, occupational therapy and developmental follow-up

dose.zh-CN: 转儿童康复和早期干预团队，针对运动、手功能、视觉和听觉制订个体化训练，并定期做发育评估。
dose.en: Refer to the children's rehabilitation and early-intervention team for an individual programme for movement, hand function, vision and hearing, with regular developmental assessment.

response.zh-CN: 康复团队会接诊并制订训练计划。本病例没有记录康复或发育随访的情况；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The rehabilitation team will see him and draw up a programme. This case does not record any therapy or developmental follow-up; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 按肾病综合征剂量口服泼尼松
name.en: Oral prednisolone at the nephrotic-syndrome dose

dose.zh-CN: 泼尼松每日2 mg/kg（60 mg/m²），口服。

harm.zh-CN: 他的尿里有β2微球蛋白 > 500 µg/L和广泛性氨基酸尿，这是肾小管漏出，不是肾小球病；肾病综合征还要有血清白蛋白 < 30 g/L（没有白蛋白结果时才看水肿），这里都没有记录（IPNA 2022临床实践建议）。激素对肾小管性蛋白尿没有作用，却可能升高眼压——他做过青光眼手术——还会增加感染、影响生长。
harm.en: His urine shows a tubular leak — β2-microglobulin above 500 µg/L with generalised aminoaciduria — not glomerular disease. Nephrotic syndrome also needs a serum albumin below 30 g/L (oedema counts only when no albumin is available), and neither is recorded (IPNA 2022 clinical practice recommendations). Steroids do nothing for tubular proteinuria but can raise the eye pressure — he has had glaucoma surgery — besides adding infection risk and slowing growth.

response.zh-CN: 已开始泼尼松。本病例没有记录用过激素；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Prednisolone started. This case does not record any steroid; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 告诉父母以后再生孩子不会再得这种病
name.en: Tell the parents a future baby will not have this condition

dose.zh-CN: 告诉父母：这种病不会在今后的孩子身上再出现，再次怀孕不需要特别检查。
dose.en: Tell the parents that the condition will not recur in future children and that a future pregnancy needs no special testing.

harm.zh-CN: 这是虚假的保证。没有哪项检查能保证下一个孩子一定不受影响：即使父母血液检测阴性，变异仍可能存在于卵子或精子中（生殖腺嵌合），因此仍可能有虽小却真实的再发风险（GeneReviews关于他这种病的章节，2019年更新）。这样说会让家庭在再次怀孕时失去遗传咨询和产前或胚胎植入前检测的机会。
harm.en: False reassurance. No test can promise that a future baby will be unaffected: even when a parent's blood test is negative, a variant can be present in the egg or sperm cells (germline mosaicism), so a small but real recurrence risk can remain (GeneReviews chapter on his condition, 2019 update). Saying this takes away the family's chance of counselling and of prenatal or pre-implantation testing in a future pregnancy.

response.zh-CN: 已经这样告诉了父母。本病例没有记录这样的谈话；不模拟其后果。
response.en: The parents have been told this. This case does not record such a conversation; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 出院回家，只做社区康复，半年后门诊复查
name.en: Discharge home with community physiotherapy only and clinic review in six months

dose.zh-CN: 办理出院，社区康复训练，6个月后儿科门诊复查。
dose.en: Discharge, community physiotherapy, paediatric clinic in six months.

harm.zh-CN: 现在让他出院，会让该做的检查和治疗都落空：漏掉的肾小管疾病会让酸中毒影响生长和骨骼，听力损失得不到干预会耽误语言（JCIH 2019），儿童白内障术后眼压升高会造成不可逆的视神经损害。要等肾脏、眼科、听力、康复和遗传各团队共同制订好计划，他才能出院。
harm.en: Sending him home now leaves his work-up and care undone: a missed kidney-tubule disorder lets acidosis harm growth and bone, unaided hearing loss delays language (JCIH 2019), and raised eye pressure after childhood cataract surgery damages the optic nerve irreversibly. He goes home only with a joint plan from the kidney, eye, hearing, therapy and genetics teams.

response.zh-CN: 已办理出院。本病例没有记录他何时出院以及出院后的安排；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Discharged. This case does not record when he went home or the arrangements made; it does not simulate the consequences.

title.zh-CN: 向家属了解他的发育、眼病和出生经过
title.en: Hear about his development, his eyes and his birth

hint.zh-CN: 他不会说话，由家属回答：他的运动从什么时候开始落后？眼睛出过什么问题、怎么治的？出生时有没有可能伤到大脑的情况？家里其他孩子怎么样？
hint.en: He can't speak, so his relative answers: when did his movement start to fall behind, what happened to his eyes and how was it treated, was there anything at birth that could have harmed his brain, and how are the other children in the family?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁，向陪同的家属了解病史。
guidance.en: Go to the cot side and take the history from his relative.

title.zh-CN: 检查他的反应、运动功能、肌张力、反射和眼睛
title.en: Examine his responses, motor function, tone, reflexes and eyes

hint.zh-CN: 哪些体征能告诉你，他的无力来自大脑，还是来自神经和肌肉？眼睛手术留下了什么？
hint.en: Which signs will tell you whether his weakness comes from the brain or from the nerves and muscles? And what have the eye operations left behind?

guidance.en: Examine him at the cot side.

title.en: Decide which tests to send first

hint.zh-CN: 哪些检查有可能把他的眼睛、神经肌肉和其他系统的问题放在一起解释？哪项检查虽然重要，却不该第一个做？
hint.en: Which tests could explain his eyes, his nerves and muscles and any other system together — and which test, however important, should not come first?

guidance.en: Answer decision 1 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 读懂首批结果，找出一个统一的解释
title.en: Read the first results and find one explanation

hint.zh-CN: 把血气和尿pH放在一起看，说明什么？尿里漏出来的是哪类蛋白、哪些物质，指向肾脏的哪一段？SMN1的结果改变了什么？
hint.en: What do the blood gas and the urine pH mean when you read them together? Which kind of protein and which substances are leaking into the urine, and which part of the kidney does that point to? What does the SMN1 result change?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅血气、血红蛋白、尿液检查、SMN1、脑电图和听觉诱发电位结果，作答决策2，并在征得家属同意后送检基因。
guidance.en: Read the blood gas, haemoglobin, urine tests, SMN1, EEG and auditory evoked potentials, answer decision 2, and send the genetic test with the family's consent.

hint.zh-CN: 开始治疗之前，你还需要知道哪几个数值？用什么途径、多大剂量、怎样调整，依据是什么？
hint.en: Which values do you need before you start treatment? Which route and dose will you choose, how will you adjust it, and why?

guidance.zh-CN: 作答决策3，并在床旁开始你选定的治疗。
guidance.en: Answer decision 3 and start the treatment you chose at the cot side.

title.zh-CN: 与家属沟通，安排他的长期随访
title.en: Talk with his family and plan his long-term follow-up

hint.zh-CN: 如果母亲的血液检测是阴性，能说明什么、不能说明什么？还有谁需要检测，谁不需要？他以后要定期看哪些专科，为什么？
hint.en: If his mother's blood test is negative, what does that show — and what can it not show? Who else should be offered testing, and who not? Which specialists does he need to keep seeing, and why?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅基因检测报告，作答决策4和决策5，与父母面谈，安排眼科、听力和康复随访，最后调阅本病例记录的结局。
guidance.en: Read the genetic report, answer decisions 4 and 5, hold the counselling meeting, arrange the eye, hearing and therapy follow-up, then read the recorded outcome.

prompt.zh-CN: 11月龄男婴，抬头不稳、不能独坐，8个月时还不会翻身；婴儿期因先天性白内障和青光眼做过手术。查体反应迟钝，扶着也站不起来，不能抓握、换手，四肢松软、肌张力低，腱反射引不出。现在先送哪些检查？（选出所有合适的）
prompt.en: An 11-month-old boy has unsteady head control, cannot sit and could not roll at 8 months; he had surgery for congenital cataracts and glaucoma in infancy. He is slow to respond, cannot stand even when held, cannot grasp or pass objects, and is floppy with low tone and tendon reflexes that cannot be elicited. Which tests do you send first? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先问清运动发育和眼病经过，并检查他的反应、扶站、抓握、肌张力和腱反射。
need.en: First take the motor and eye history, and examine his responses, standing, grasp, tone and reflexes.

text.zh-CN: 血气分析，同时查电解质、血磷、血钙和肌酐
text.en: A blood gas, with electrolytes, phosphate, calcium and creatinine

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。先天性白内障加婴儿期低张力，提示可能是累及不止一个系统的疾病；肾小管受累时，往往在肾功能衰竭之前很久就表现为代谢性酸中毒伴失钾、失磷，所以血气和电解质要尽早查。AAP 2025发育迟缓评估临床报告主张按表型选择检查，而他的表型提示问题不只在脑和肌肉。
feedback.en: Right. Congenital cataract with infantile hypotonia suggests a disorder of more than one system; when the kidney tubule is involved it shows as a metabolic acidosis with potassium and phosphate losses long before the kidneys fail, so the gas and electrolytes come early. The AAP 2025 clinical report on developmental delay chooses tests from the phenotype, and his phenotype reaches beyond the brain and muscles.

text.zh-CN: 尿常规（含尿pH）、尿蛋白定量、尿β2微球蛋白和尿氨基酸
text.en: Urinalysis with urine pH, urine protein, urine β2-microglobulin and urine amino acids

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。把尿pH和血气对照着看，再看尿蛋白的量和种类（如β2微球蛋白这类低分子蛋白）以及尿氨基酸，就能判断肾小管有没有“漏”、漏在哪一段，而且无创、便宜。按表型安排检查（AAP 2025临床报告）时，这几项就是针对肾脏的那一部分。
feedback.en: Right. The urine pH read against the blood gas, the amount and kind of protein (low-molecular-weight proteins such as β2-microglobulin) and the urine amino acids show whether the tubule is leaking and where — non-invasively and cheaply. In a phenotype-led work-up (AAP 2025 clinical report) they are the kidney part.

text.zh-CN: SMN1拷贝数检测，排查脊髓性肌萎缩
text.en: SMN1 copy-number testing for spinal muscular atrophy

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。低张力伴腱反射消失要想到前角细胞病，国际脊髓性肌萎缩诊疗共识（Mercuri等，2018）把SMN1检测作为怀疑脊髓性肌萎缩时的首选诊断检查——无创、快，阳性时有治疗可用。但它解释不了眼病，所以要和血、尿检查一起送，而不是替代它们。
feedback.en: Right. Floppiness with absent reflexes raises anterior horn cell disease, and the international SMA care consensus (Mercuri et al., 2018) makes SMN1 testing the first diagnostic test when SMA is suspected — non-invasive, quick and, if positive, treatable. It does not explain his eyes, so it goes alongside the blood and urine tests, not instead of them.

text.zh-CN: 第一步就在全身麻醉下取肌肉活检，看肌肉和神经的病理
text.en: Muscle biopsy under general anaesthesia as the very first test, for muscle and nerve histology

feedback.zh-CN: 肌肉活检需要全身麻醉。怀疑脊髓性肌萎缩时，国际诊疗共识（Mercuri等，2018）把SMN1检测作为一线检查，典型病例不需要肌活检；对任何低张力婴儿，即使需要活检，也应在SMN1和无创检查缩小范围之后。给酸碱状态未知的婴儿先上麻醉，只会增加风险，回答不了问题。
feedback.en: Muscle biopsy needs a general anaesthetic. When SMA is suspected, the international SMA care consensus (Mercuri et al., 2018) makes SMN1 testing the first-line investigation and a typical presentation needs no biopsy; in any floppy infant a biopsy comes, if at all, after SMN1 and the non-invasive tests have narrowed the question. An anaesthetic in an infant whose acid–base status is unknown adds risk without answering anything.

text.zh-CN: 先做头颅CT平扫，查找脑发育畸形或其他结构性原因
text.en: A plain head CT first, to look for a brain malformation or another structural cause of the delay

feedback.zh-CN: CT让婴儿受辐射，显示发育中的大脑也远不如MRI（需要做脑影像时用MRI）；而且任何脑部扫描都解释不了他的眼睛和肌张力为什么同时出问题、腱反射为什么引不出。AAP 2025临床报告按整体表型选择检查，所以先查血气、尿液和SMN1。
feedback.en: A CT gives an infant a radiation dose and shows the developing brain far less well than MRI, the scan used when imaging is needed; and no brain scan explains why his eyes and his tone are affected together, or why his reflexes cannot be elicited. The AAP 2025 clinical report chooses tests from the whole phenotype, so the blood gas, urine and SMN1 come first.

prompt.zh-CN: 首批结果：血气pH 7.271，HCO₃⁻ 17.9 mmol/L，BE −8.4 mmol/L；尿pH 7.0，尿蛋白0.86 g/24 h，尿β2微球蛋白 > 500 µg/L，广泛性氨基酸尿；SMN1未见异常；听觉诱发电位潜伏期延长、部分听阈异常。结合他的眼病、低张力和腱反射引不出，哪种解释最能统一全部表现？
prompt.en: First results: blood gas pH 7.271, bicarbonate 17.9 mmol/L, base excess −8.4 mmol/L; urine pH 7.0, urine protein 0.86 g/24 h, urine β2-microglobulin > 500 µg/L, generalised aminoaciduria; SMN1 without abnormality; auditory evoked potentials with prolonged latencies and partly abnormal thresholds. With his eye disease, low tone and absent reflexes, which explanation best unifies everything?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅血气、尿液检查（尿常规、尿蛋白定量、尿β2微球蛋白、尿氨基酸）、SMN1和听觉诱发电位结果。
need.en: First read the blood gas, the urine tests (urinalysis, urine protein, urine β2-microglobulin, urine amino acids), the SMN1 result and the auditory evoked potentials.

text.zh-CN: X连锁的眼脑肾综合征（Lowe综合征）：先天性白内障、婴儿期低张力无反射和近端肾小管病同出一源；送检OCRL基因确诊
text.en: An X-linked oculocerebrorenal (Lowe) syndrome: congenital cataract, infantile areflexic hypotonia and a proximal tubulopathy share one cause; confirm with OCRL testing

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。先天性白内障（伴青光眼）、婴儿期低张力伴腱反射消失，加上近端肾小管病——血液酸中毒时尿pH仍为7.0提示肾小管性酸中毒，尿β2微球蛋白 > 500 µg/L和广泛性氨基酸尿把它定位在近端小管——正是Lowe综合征的眼、脑、肾三联征，由X连锁的OCRL基因致病（GeneReviews：Lowe综合征）。SMN1未见异常，使最需要鉴别的5q型脊髓性肌萎缩可能性很小；确诊靠OCRL基因检测。
feedback.en: Right. Congenital cataract (with glaucoma), infantile hypotonia with absent reflexes and a proximal tubulopathy — a tubular acidosis (urine pH 7.0 during acidaemia) that β2-microglobulin above 500 µg/L and generalised aminoaciduria place in the proximal tubule — are the eye, brain and kidney triad of Lowe syndrome, caused by the X-linked OCRL gene (GeneReviews: Lowe syndrome). An SMN1 result without abnormality makes 5q spinal muscular atrophy, the main neuromuscular alternative, very unlikely; OCRL testing confirms the diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 肾病型胱氨酸病：婴儿期遗传性肾性范科尼综合征最常见的原因；查白细胞胱氨酸，请眼科用裂隙灯找角膜结晶
text.en: Nephropathic cystinosis, the commonest inherited cause of renal Fanconi syndrome in infancy: measure leucocyte cystine and ask for a slit-lamp search for corneal crystals

feedback.zh-CN: 胱氨酸病确实是儿童遗传性肾性范科尼综合征最常见的原因，多在1岁以内出现，值得想到；但它的眼部表现是角膜胱氨酸结晶，不是先天性白内障或青光眼，也不会从婴儿早期就出现低张力和腱反射消失（胱氨酸病国际共识，2014）。
feedback.en: Cystinosis is indeed the commonest inherited cause of renal Fanconi syndrome in children and usually shows in the first year, so it is worth thinking of — but its eye sign is corneal cystine crystals, not congenital cataract or glaucoma, and it does not cause hypotonia with absent reflexes from early infancy (international cystinosis consensus, 2014).

text.zh-CN: 伴感音神经性耳聋的遗传性远端肾小管酸中毒（ATP6V1B1/ATP6V0A4）：能解释血酸而尿pH 7.0和听力异常；开始碱剂并查基因
text.en: Inherited distal renal tubular acidosis with sensorineural deafness (ATP6V1B1/ATP6V0A4), explaining acidaemia with a urine pH of 7.0 and the hearing; start alkali, test the genes

feedback.zh-CN: 远端肾小管酸中毒伴耳聋能解释“血酸而尿不酸”和听力异常，但不会有先天性白内障、青光眼和低张力无反射。远端肾小管酸中毒也会出现氨基酸尿和低分子蛋白尿，主要见于酸中毒严重、尚未治疗的婴儿，补碱后消退（ERKNet/ESPN远端肾小管酸中毒临床实践要点，2021）；他的血碳酸氢根为17.9 mmol/L，再结合眼病和肌张力，这种漏出更符合原发的近端肾小管病。
feedback.en: Distal RTA with deafness explains acid blood with a urine that is not acid, and the hearing result — but it brings no congenital cataract, glaucoma or areflexic hypotonia. A leak of amino acids and low-molecular-weight protein does occur in distal RTA, mainly in untreated infants with severe acidosis, and settles on alkali (ERKNet/ESPN clinical practice points on distal RTA, 2021); his bicarbonate is 17.9 mmol/L, and with his eyes and his tone the leak fits a primary proximal tubulopathy.

text.zh-CN: 先天性风疹综合征：白内障、青光眼、听力受损和发育落后都能用它解释；查风疹抗体，必要时取标本做病毒检测
text.en: Congenital rubella syndrome, which accounts for cataract, glaucoma, impaired hearing and developmental delay; send rubella antibodies and, if needed, samples for the virus

feedback.zh-CN: 先天性风疹确实可以同时有白内障、青光眼、听力损害和发育落后，但不会造成广泛的近端肾小管漏出；而且到11个月时，风疹抗体可能来自母亲、生后感染或疫苗接种，很难解读。解释必须符合包括肾脏在内的整体表型（AAP 2025临床报告）。
feedback.en: Congenital rubella can combine cataract, glaucoma, hearing loss and developmental delay, but it does not cause a generalised proximal tubular leak; and at 11 months rubella antibodies may come from the mother, a later infection or vaccination, so they are hard to read. The explanation has to fit the whole phenotype, kidneys included (AAP 2025 clinical report).

text.zh-CN: 婴儿型肾病综合征，眼病是巧合：尿蛋白0.86 g/24 h，按肾病综合征口服泼尼松，等蛋白尿缓解后再评估发育
text.en: Infantile nephrotic syndrome with unrelated eye disease, given 0.86 g/24 h of protein: start prednisolone and reassess his development once the proteinuria remits

feedback.zh-CN: 按他记录的8.7 kg体重，0.86 g/24 h的尿蛋白不算少，但β2微球蛋白 > 500 µg/L和广泛性氨基酸尿提示的是肾小管漏出。肾病综合征需要肾病水平蛋白尿加血清白蛋白 < 30 g/L，只有没有白蛋白结果时才以水肿代替（IPNA 2022临床实践建议）；这里既没有记录白蛋白，也没有记录水肿，而激素止不住肾小管漏出。
feedback.en: For his recorded weight of 8.7 kg, 0.86 g/24 h is a lot of protein, but β2-microglobulin above 500 µg/L with generalised aminoaciduria marks a tubular leak. Nephrotic syndrome needs nephrotic-range proteinuria with a serum albumin below 30 g/L, oedema counting only when no albumin is available (IPNA 2022 clinical practice recommendations); no albumin or oedema is recorded, and steroids do not stop a tubular leak.

prompt.zh-CN: 他的血气pH 7.271，HCO₃⁻ 17.9 mmol/L，BE −8.4 mmol/L，尿pH 7.0；你已判断为近端肾小管病。血钾、血磷、血钙和肌酐目前都不知道。现在怎样处理酸中毒？
prompt.en: His blood gas shows pH 7.271, bicarbonate 17.9 mmol/L and base excess −8.4 mmol/L, with a urine pH of 7.0, and you have judged this a proximal tubulopathy. His potassium, phosphate, calcium and creatinine are not known. How do you treat the acidosis now?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策2，并调阅血气和尿常规。
need.en: Answer decision 2 first, and read the blood gas and the urinalysis.

text.zh-CN: 先查钾、磷、钙和肌酐，再口服枸橼酸盐（或碳酸氢钠），每日分3–4次，按血碳酸氢根加量至正常，补钾看实测值
text.en: Send potassium, phosphate, calcium and creatinine, then oral citrate (or bicarbonate) in 3–4 daily doses, raised to a normal serum bicarbonate; potassium as the level requires

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。口服碱剂全天分次给药（这个月龄可随喂奶少量给）、按血碳酸氢根调整到正常，是控制肾小管性酸中毒的方法——ERKNet/ESPN 2021临床实践要点为远端肾小管酸中毒规定了这一做法，GeneReviews（2019）对Lowe综合征的近端肾小管病同样如此，并按需补钾、补磷和骨化三醇；近端丢失需要的剂量大得多。碱化会让血钾进一步下降，所以先测钾、磷、钙和肌酐，再决定用不用含钾制剂和补充剂。
feedback.en: Right. Oral alkali divided through the day (at his age, small amounts with his feeds) and titrated to a normal serum bicarbonate is how a tubular acidosis is controlled — the ERKNet/ESPN 2021 practice points set it out for distal RTA, and GeneReviews (2019) treats the proximal tubulopathy of Lowe syndrome the same way, with potassium, phosphate and calcitriol as needed; proximal wasting needs far larger doses. Alkali lowers potassium further, so potassium, phosphate, calcium and creatinine come first and decide the potassium salt and supplements.

text.zh-CN: 按“碱缺失 × 体重 × 0.3”算出碳酸氢钠总量，现在先在30分钟内静脉推注一半，1小时后复查血气，再根据结果决定是否补足另一半
text.en: Work out the bicarbonate as base deficit × weight × 0.3 and give half of it now as an IV bolus over 30 minutes; recheck the gas an hour later and let that result decide the other half

feedback.zh-CN: 这是急性重度酸中毒的做法，不适合pH 7.271的慢性肾小管性酸中毒，后者用口服碱剂纠正（ERKNet/ESPN 2021临床实践要点；GeneReviews，2019）。静脉补进的碳酸氢根一超过降低了的近端阈值就从尿中丢失；他的血钾和血钙都不知道，快速碱化可诱发严重低钾和低钙抽搐，还加重钠负荷。
feedback.en: This is an approach for acute, severe acidosis, not for a chronic tubular acidosis at pH 7.271, which oral alkali corrects (ERKNet/ESPN 2021 clinical practice points; GeneReviews, 2019). Infused bicarbonate above the lowered proximal threshold is soon lost in the urine, and with his potassium and calcium unknown, rapid alkalinisation can precipitate severe hypokalaemia and hypocalcaemic tetany, besides a sodium load.

text.zh-CN: 酸中毒不重、而且是慢性的，先不用碱剂；等基因结果明确病因后再由肾脏科决定是否治疗，其间每周复查一次血气
text.en: The acidosis is mild and chronic, so hold alkali until the gene result confirms the cause and nephrology decides, with a blood gas every week meanwhile

feedback.zh-CN: 治疗酸中毒不需要等病因确诊：持续的代谢性酸中毒会影响婴儿的生长和骨骼，而把碳酸氢根纠正到正常的碱剂治疗可以避免大部分并发症（ERKNet/ESPN 2021远端肾小管酸中毒临床实践要点）。等基因结果，只会让损害持续更久。
feedback.en: Treating the acidosis does not wait for the cause: persistent metabolic acidosis impairs an infant's growth and bones, and alkali that brings the bicarbonate back to normal prevents most of the complications (ERKNet/ESPN 2021 clinical practice points on distal RTA). Waiting for the genetic result only prolongs the harm.

text.zh-CN: 口服碳酸氢钠每日1–2 mmol/kg，早上一次顿服，长期不变；尿pH已经偏碱，剂量不必再加，以免尿更碱
text.en: Oral sodium bicarbonate 1–2 mmol/kg once each morning, kept unchanged; the urine is already alkaline, so the dose should not be raised and make it more so

feedback.zh-CN: 方向对，剂量和用法不对：近端小管病时，碳酸氢根一超过阈值就从尿中丢失，需要更大的剂量、全天分次给，并按血碳酸氢根而不是尿pH调整——血碳酸氢根正常正是ERKNet/ESPN 2021临床实践要点为远端肾小管酸中毒设定的目标。每日一次的小剂量会让他一天中大部分时间仍处于酸中毒。
feedback.en: Right direction, wrong dose and schedule: in proximal disease bicarbonate is lost in the urine as soon as it exceeds the threshold, so larger doses split through the day are needed, titrated to the serum bicarbonate rather than the urine pH — a normal serum bicarbonate is the target the ERKNet/ESPN 2021 practice points set for distal RTA. A small once-daily dose leaves him acidotic for most of the day.

prompt.zh-CN: 基因报告：他的OCRL1（OCRL）基因第15外显子c.1528C>T无义变异；母亲外周血和20条对照染色体中未检出。你怎样向父母解释这个结果？
prompt.en: The genetic report: a nonsense variant in exon 15 of OCRL1 (OCRL), c.1528C>T, in him; not detected in his mother's peripheral blood or in 20 control chromosomes. How do you explain this to his parents?

need.en: Read the genetic test report first.

text.zh-CN: 变异解释了他的病；母亲血中阴性不能排除生殖腺嵌合，再发风险低但不为零：遗传咨询、母亲裂隙灯查晶状体，再孕可做产前或植入前检测
text.en: It explains his condition; her negative blood test does not exclude germline mosaicism, so the risk is low, not zero: counselling, a slit-lamp lens check for her, prenatal or pre-implantation testing next time

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。在OCRL这种以功能丧失致病的基因中，无义变异加上高度特异的眼脑肾表型，按ACMG/AMP 2015标准属于致病证据（PVS1，并以表型特异作支持）。母亲血液阴性降低但不能消除再发风险，因为变异可能只存在于她的卵细胞（生殖腺嵌合）；应如实解释，并提供遗传咨询以及再次怀孕时的产前或胚胎植入前检测——携带者女性多可在裂隙灯下看到晶状体混浊（GeneReviews：Lowe综合征）。
feedback.en: Right. A nonsense variant in OCRL, a gene in which loss of function causes disease, with a highly specific eye–brain–kidney phenotype is pathogenic evidence under ACMG/AMP 2015 (PVS1, with phenotype specificity as support). A negative maternal blood test lowers but does not remove the recurrence risk, because the variant may be present in her egg cells only (germline mosaicism); explain this and offer counselling and prenatal or pre-implantation testing in a future pregnancy — carrier women usually show lens opacities on slit-lamp examination (GeneReviews: Lowe syndrome).

text.zh-CN: 母亲血液阴性，说明变异是他自己新发生的；以后的孩子风险和一般人一样，再次怀孕不需要任何特殊检查或咨询
text.en: His mother's blood is negative, so the variant arose new in him; future children carry no more risk than anyone else's, and a future pregnancy needs no special testing or counselling

feedback.zh-CN: 这是虚假的保证。外周血阴性不能排除生殖腺嵌合，Lowe综合征患儿的母亲中已有生殖腺嵌合的报道（GeneReviews：Lowe综合征）；这样说会让家庭在再次怀孕时失去产前或胚胎植入前检测的机会。
feedback.en: False reassurance. A negative blood test cannot exclude germline mosaicism, which has been reported in mothers of boys with Lowe syndrome (GeneReviews: Lowe syndrome); the family would lose the chance of prenatal or pre-implantation testing in a future pregnancy.

text.zh-CN: 这是X连锁病，母亲一定是携带者，她血里没查到只是假阴性；以后每个儿子都有50%的风险得病，每个女儿有50%的可能是携带者，应劝他们不再生育
text.en: This is X-linked, so his mother must be a carrier and her blood result is a false negative; each future son has a 50 % risk of the condition and each daughter of being a carrier, so they should be advised against more children

feedback.zh-CN: 每个儿子50%的风险适用于杂合携带者母亲，但她的血液检测没有查到这个变异，不能把阴性结果当作假阴性；夸大风险、劝其不再生育，和否认风险一样有害。剩余的风险来自可能的生殖腺嵌合，应在非指导性的遗传咨询中如实说明（GeneReviews：Lowe综合征）。
feedback.en: A 50 % risk to each son applies to a heterozygous carrier mother, but her blood test did not find the variant, and a negative result is not to be dismissed as false; overstating the risk and advising against more children harms as much as denying it. The residual risk comes from possible germline mosaicism, which non-directive counselling should state honestly (GeneReviews: Lowe syndrome).

text.zh-CN: 现在就给10岁的哥哥检测这个变异，看他是不是携带者，好早做打算；母亲既然阴性，就不需要再做遗传咨询了
text.en: Test his 10-year-old brother for the variant now to see whether he is a carrier and plan ahead; with the mother negative, no further genetic counselling is needed

feedback.zh-CN: 健康的10岁哥哥不是患者——患病的男孩生来就有白内障——男孩也不可能是X连锁病的“携带者”，给他检测回答不了任何问题；携带者检测针对的是母系的女性亲属，而且检测前后都需要遗传咨询（GeneReviews：Lowe综合征）。
feedback.en: His healthy 10-year-old brother is not affected — affected boys have cataracts from birth — and a boy cannot be a ‘carrier’ of an X-linked condition, so testing him answers nothing; carrier testing is for female relatives on the mother's side, with counselling before and after (GeneReviews: Lowe syndrome).

text.zh-CN: 一个只在他身上找到的无义变化，可能是意义不明的变异；先送第二家实验室复核，确认之前不和家属谈遗传问题
text.en: A single nonsense change found only in him may be a variant of uncertain significance: have a second laboratory repeat it, and say nothing about inheritance until it is confirmed

feedback.zh-CN: OCRL的无义变化预示功能丧失，而功能丧失正是这个病的致病机制，按ACMG/AMP 2015属于非常强的致病证据（PVS1）；再加上他高度特异的三系统表型，这不是意义不明的变异，没有理由等第二家实验室复核后才向家属解释。拖延解释，只会让家庭在最需要信息的时候得不到信息。
feedback.en: A nonsense change in OCRL predicts loss of function — the mechanism of this disease — which ACMG/AMP 2015 grades as very strong evidence of pathogenicity (PVS1), and his highly specific three-system phenotype adds to it: this is no variant of uncertain significance, and there is no reason to hold back the explanation while a second laboratory repeats the test. Delay leaves the family without information when they need it most.

prompt.zh-CN: 诊断已经明确。出院前，他的长期随访应包括哪些内容？（选出所有合适的）
prompt.en: The diagnosis is confirmed. Before he goes home, what should his long-term follow-up include? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先调阅基因检测报告，并作答决策4。
need.en: Read the genetic report and answer decision 4 first.

text.zh-CN: 儿童眼科终身随访：定期测眼压，术眼的屈光矫正和弱视治疗
text.en: Lifelong paediatric ophthalmology: regular intraocular pressure checks, optical correction of the operated eyes and amblyopia care

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。做过白内障手术的孩子终身都有发生或复发青光眼的风险，Lowe综合征本身也常伴青光眼，眼压升高造成的视神经损害不可逆；术眼还需要屈光矫正和弱视治疗（GeneReviews：Lowe综合征）。
feedback.en: Right. A child who has had cataract surgery carries a lifelong risk of glaucoma arising or recurring, Lowe syndrome itself often brings glaucoma, and optic-nerve damage from raised pressure is irreversible; the operated eyes also need optical correction and amblyopia care (GeneReviews: Lowe syndrome).

text.zh-CN: 尽快做诊断性听力评估（频率特异性ABR），证实听力损失后验配助听器并转早期干预
text.en: A diagnostic hearing assessment (frequency-specific ABR) without delay, then hearing aids and early intervention once a loss is confirmed

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。听觉诱发电位已经异常，他又已经11个月，按JCIH 2019的“1-3-6”原则早已超过确诊和干预的时间点；应立即做诊断性评估，证实后尽早验配助听器、开始早期干预，不必等到他开口说话。
feedback.en: Right. His auditory evoked potentials are already abnormal and at 11 months he is well past the JCIH 2019 ‘1-3-6’ benchmarks for diagnosis and intervention, so the diagnostic assessment happens now, with hearing aids and early intervention as soon as a loss is confirmed — not once he starts talking.

text.zh-CN: 儿童肾脏科定期复查血碳酸氢根、钾、磷、钙、肌酐和生长，监测佝偻病，并做泌尿系超声
text.en: Regular paediatric nephrology review of bicarbonate, potassium, phosphate, calcium, creatinine and growth, with rickets surveillance and a kidney ultrasound

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。碱剂、补钾和补磷的剂量要随生长反复调整，范科尼型肾小管病会导致佝偻病和生长落后，Lowe综合征的肾功能还会随年龄逐渐下降，需要长期监测（GeneReviews：Lowe综合征）。
feedback.en: Right. Alkali, potassium and phosphate doses need repeated adjustment as he grows, a Fanconi-type tubulopathy causes rickets and poor growth, and kidney function in Lowe syndrome declines with age, so monitoring is lifelong (GeneReviews: Lowe syndrome).

text.zh-CN: 碱剂把碳酸氢根纠正到正常以后，就可以停掉肾脏的血、尿化验，因为基因诊断已经解释了肾脏的问题
text.en: Once alkali has brought the bicarbonate back to normal, the kidney blood and urine tests can stop, because the genetic diagnosis already explains his kidneys

feedback.zh-CN: 基因诊断解释了病因，却不会让肾小管停止丢失：剂量要随生长调整，佝偻病和肾功能下降只能靠长期化验发现（GeneReviews：Lowe综合征）。停止监测，会让这些问题悄悄发展。
feedback.en: The genetic diagnosis explains the cause but does not stop the tubular losses: doses change as he grows, and rickets and declining kidney function are found only by continued testing (GeneReviews: Lowe syndrome). Stopping the tests lets them develop unseen.

text.zh-CN: 助听的事等眼睛和运动康复都稳定以后再说，到2岁时看他说话的情况，再决定要不要复查听力
text.en: Hearing aids can wait until his eyes and motor therapy are settled; whether to repeat the hearing test is decided from how he talks at 2 years

feedback.zh-CN: 等到2岁看说话再决定，会错过语言发育的关键期；JCIH 2019要求听力损失尽早确诊、尽早干预，而视力受损的孩子更依赖听力。
feedback.en: Waiting to judge from his speech at 2 years loses the critical period for language; JCIH 2019 asks for hearing loss to be confirmed and treated as early as possible, and a child with impaired vision depends all the more on hearing.

text.zh-CN: 问清运动发育（抬头、独坐、翻身）、眼病和手术经过、出生经过（第几胎、孕周、分娩方式、有无窒息抢救）以及哥哥的健康
text.en: Elicited his motor milestones (head control, sitting, rolling), the eye disease and its surgery, the birth (birth order, gestation, mode, no asphyxia or resuscitation) and his brother's health

text.zh-CN: 追问了答案目前仍然未知的关键问题：母系男孩中有无类似疾病、听力和听力筛查、尿量和饮水、孕期感染、新生儿期情况
text.en: Asked the key questions whose answers are still unknown here: similar illness in boys on the mother's side, hearing and the newborn hearing screen, urine output and thirst, infection in pregnancy, and the newborn period

text.zh-CN: 观察了一般反应、扶站和抓握换手，检查了四肢肌张力和腱反射，并检查了双眼
text.en: Observed his responses, standing with support and grasping and passing objects, tested limb tone and tendon reflexes, and examined both eyes

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对首批检查，并调阅了血气、四项尿液检查、SMN1和听觉诱发电位结果
text.en: Chose the first tests correctly at the first attempt, and read the blood gas, the four urine results, SMN1 and the auditory evoked potentials

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把眼病、低张力无反射和近端肾小管病归为同一个X连锁综合征，并在知情同意后送检基因
text.en: Brought the eye disease, areflexic hypotonia and the proximal tubulopathy together as one X-linked syndrome at the first attempt, and sent the gene test after consent

text.zh-CN: 基因结果回来之前，先送检电解质（钾、磷、钙、肌酐），再在看过血气后开始口服碱剂
text.en: Before the genetic result, sent the electrolytes (potassium, phosphate, calcium, creatinine) first and then, with the blood gas read, started oral alkali

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对酸中毒的处理方案，请儿童肾脏科会诊，并送检骨代谢、尿钙尿磷尿糖和贫血检查
text.en: Chose the acid–base plan at the first attempt, involved paediatric nephrology, and sent the bone, urine-mineral and anaemia tests

text.zh-CN: 没有给他静脉推注碳酸氢钠
text.en: Gave him no IV sodium bicarbonate bolus

text.zh-CN: 没有按肾病综合征用激素，没有向父母保证不会再发，也没有只安排社区康复就让他出院
text.en: Gave no steroids for presumed nephrotic syndrome, made no promise of zero recurrence to the parents, and did not discharge him with community physiotherapy alone

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确说明母亲阴性结果的含义和剩余的再发风险，并安排了检测后遗传咨询
text.en: Explained the mother's negative result and the residual recurrence risk correctly at the first attempt, and held post-test genetic counselling

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对长期随访内容，并转诊眼科、听力学和早期干预
text.en: Chose the long-term surveillance at the first attempt and referred him to ophthalmology, audiology and early intervention

text.zh-CN: 用家属听得懂的话解释他的病、治疗、遗传方式和不确定性，并确认对方理解
text.en: Explained his condition, the treatment, the inheritance and its uncertainties in words the family understands, and checked their understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始、收集信息、解释与计划、结束）：在床旁向家属介绍自己，先问清对方是孩子的什么人、已经知道些什么；问家属最担心什么（他为什么落后这么多；拿到基因结果后，是不是家里遗传、以后的孩子会不会这样、哥哥有没有事）。用通俗的话说明：他的眼睛、身体发软和肾脏“漏”酸、漏蛋白和氨基酸是同一个原因；为什么先查血和尿，而不是先做脑部检查；为什么要每天分几次口服药物纠正酸、定期抽血，而“打一针很快纠正”并不安全。基因诊断是坏消息，用SPIKES告知：找安静的房间，请孩子父母（尽量两人都在）和护士一起；先问他们已经知道什么、想知道多少；说结果前先给预告，用通俗的话分小段讲；留出时间让他们表达情绪并共情回应；最后总结并说明下一步。基因结果出来后，说明变化在X染色体的一个基因上，在妈妈血里没有查到，但不能完全排除妈妈的卵细胞里有，所以以后的孩子仍有很小的风险——既不说成零，也不说成一半；提供遗传咨询、再次怀孕时的检测和妈妈的晶状体检查；说明10岁的哥哥身体健康，不需要做这项检测。讲清以后由哪些专科一起随访（肾脏、眼科、听力、康复）。用回授法确认理解，请对方提问，给书面总结，约好下次谈话。不好的表现：随口告知结果、不先问对方想知道多少，满口术语不加解释（范科尼、嵌合、半合子），保证他以后能正常发育，把风险说成零或50%，暗示是妈妈的错，或谈完没有随访计划。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering information, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves at the cot side and first asks who the relative is to him and what they already know; asks what worries them most (why he is so far behind; once the genetic result is back, whether it runs in the family, whether another baby could have it, whether his brother is all right). Explains in plain words that his eyes, his floppiness and his kidneys' leak of acid, protein and amino acids have one cause; why blood and urine tests come before any brain scan; and why he needs medicine by mouth several times a day for the acid, with regular blood tests, while an injection to ‘correct it quickly’ is not safe. The genetic diagnosis is bad news and is broken with SPIKES: a quiet room, his parents invited (both if possible) with the nurse, first what they already know and how much they want to know, a warning before the result, plain words in small pieces, time for their feelings with an empathic response, and a summary with the next steps. After the genetic result, explains that the change is in a gene on the X chromosome, that it was not found in his mum's blood, but that it cannot be completely ruled out in her egg cells, so a future baby still has a small chance — neither zero nor one in two; offers a genetics appointment, testing in a future pregnancy and a lens check for his mum; says that his healthy 10-year-old brother does not need this test. Names the teams who will follow him together (kidneys, eyes, hearing, therapy). Checks understanding by teach-back, invites questions, gives a written summary and agrees when to talk again. Not good: giving the result in passing or before asking what they want to know, unexplained jargon (Fanconi, mosaicism, hemizygous), promising normal development, calling the risk zero or 50 %, implying it is his mother's fault, or ending without a follow-up plan.

name.zh-CN: 严医生（儿科上级医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科上级医师，用苏格拉底式提问带教，按PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经得到的资料提问，例如：“他运动发育落后，婴儿期又做过眼部手术——除了神经系统，你还会查哪个系统？为什么？”“如果腱反射引不出，你首先想到哪一类病？他身上又有哪些表现不太符合？”“血是酸的时候，尿pH应该是多少？如果不是，说明什么？”“尿里查到哪类蛋白、哪些物质，能把问题定位到肾小管的哪一段？”“开始纠正酸中毒之前，你还需要哪几个数值？为什么？”“如果母亲的血液检测是阴性，能排除什么、不能排除什么？谁需要检测，谁不需要？”“出院前，他需要哪些专科长期随访？”说明这是2012年发表的历史病例：本病例只记录到基因诊断，没有记录当年的治疗和随访，今天的处理以现行指南为准。不提前透露诊断、决策答案或结局，陷阱和答案留到复盘时再讲；生命体征、身长和头围、电解质、血磷、血钙、肌酐、白蛋白、尿糖、红细胞指数、眼压和视力、听力筛查、新生儿期情况、父母和母系亲属的病史都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Paediatric attending who teaches by Socratic questions and debriefs with PEARLS, asking only about what the learner already has, e.g. “His motor development is behind and he had eye surgery in infancy — besides the nervous system, which other system would you check, and why?”, “If the tendon reflexes cannot be elicited, which group of diseases comes first to mind, and what about him fits it poorly?”, “When the blood is acidic, what should the urine pH be — and if it is not, what does that mean?”, “Which proteins and substances in the urine place the problem in a particular part of the tubule?”, “Which values do you need before you correct the acidosis, and why?”, “If his mother's blood test is negative, what does that rule out — and what not? Who needs testing and who does not?”, “Which specialists does he need to keep seeing after discharge?”. Explains that this is a historical case published in 2012: the case records the course only up to the genetic diagnosis, with no treatment or follow-up, and today's management follows current guidance. Never reveals the diagnosis, a decision's answer or the outcome early, and keeps the traps and answers for the debrief; vital signs, length and head circumference, electrolytes, phosphate, calcium, creatinine, albumin, urine glucose, red-cell indices, eye pressures and vision, the hearing screen, the newborn period and the history of the parents and maternal relatives are not recorded — never supply them.

name.zh-CN: 范护士（儿科病房）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：11月龄男婴，因运动发育落后入院，至今抬头不稳、不能独坐；婴儿期做过眼部手术；记录的体重8.7 kg；家属陪在床旁。可以协助抽血、留尿标本（包括24小时尿）、送检，联系眼科、听力学、康复科和遗传科，并按医嘱给药。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（如生命体征、尿量、出入量、用过的药）时，直接说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Paediatric ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): boy aged 11 months admitted with delayed motor development — head control still unsteady, unable to sit unsupported; eye surgery in infancy; recorded weight 8.7 kg; a relative is at the cot side. Can help with bloods, urine samples (including a 24-hour collection), sending samples, contacting ophthalmology, audiology, rehabilitation and genetics, and giving prescribed medicines. Reads orders back, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (vital signs, urine output, fluid balance, medicines given).

name.zh-CN: 顾医生（儿童肾脏科会诊）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童肾脏科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的结果。可以讲：酸中毒时尿pH的意义（远端酸化障碍，或近端碳酸氢根阈值降低、超过阈值即从尿中丢失）；β2微球蛋白等低分子蛋白和广泛性氨基酸尿为什么把病变定位在近端小管（远端肾小管酸中毒时这种漏出主要见于酸中毒严重、未经治疗的婴儿，补碱后消退）；诊断肾性范科尼综合征还要查什么（血钾、血磷、血钙、尿糖、尿钙、肌酐、碱性磷酸酶和甲状旁腺激素）；没有血钠和血氯就算不了阴离子间隙；口服碱剂的原则（枸橼酸盐或碳酸氢钠，尽量频繁给药——婴儿随喂奶少量给，年长儿每日3–4次——按血碳酸氢根调整，近端丢失需要较大剂量，先知道血钾）；为什么不静脉推注碳酸氢钠；为什么肾小管性蛋白尿不是肾病综合征、不用激素（IPNA 2022的定义：肾病水平蛋白尿加血清白蛋白 < 30 g/L）；综合征性近端肾小管病的肾功能可随年龄下降，需要长期随访；贫血要单独查原因，不能都归到肾脏病上。不提前给出决策答案，不补充没有记录的结果。
knowledge.en: Paediatric nephrology consultant who interprets only results the learner has already read. Can explain what the urine pH means during an acidosis (a distal acidification defect, or a lowered proximal bicarbonate threshold with losses above it); why low-molecular-weight proteins such as β2-microglobulin and generalised aminoaciduria place the lesion in the proximal tubule (in distal RTA such a leak is seen mainly in untreated infants with severe acidosis and settles on alkali); what else a renal Fanconi syndrome needs (potassium, phosphate, calcium, urine glucose and calcium, creatinine, alkaline phosphatase, PTH); that without sodium and chloride no anion gap can be calculated; the principles of oral alkali (citrate or bicarbonate, as often as possible — small amounts with feeds in an infant, 3–4 doses a day in older children — titrated to the serum bicarbonate, larger doses for proximal losses, potassium known first); why not an IV bicarbonate bolus; why tubular proteinuria is not nephrotic syndrome and is not treated with steroids (IPNA 2022 definition: nephrotic-range proteinuria with a serum albumin below 30 g/L); that kidney function in a syndromic proximal tubulopathy can decline with age, so follow-up is lifelong; and that an anaemia needs its own work-up rather than being put down to the kidney disease. Never gives a decision's answer early and adds no result the case does not record.

name.zh-CN: 沈医生（临床遗传科会诊）

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床遗传科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的结果。看到基因报告之前，只讨论SMN1检测能排除什么、不能排除什么（常见的SMN1缺失型脊髓性肌萎缩），以及怎样按表型选择基因检测（AAP 2025临床报告）并取得知情同意。学员看过基因报告之后，可以讲：X连锁遗传，男孩为半合子；报告所用旧基因名对应的现行HGNC符号，HGVS写法（c.与p.、参考转录本）；按ACMG/AMP 2015判读无义变异（PVS1）及支持证据，“20条对照染色体”与今天人群数据库的区别；母亲外周血检测能说明什么、不能说明什么，以及生殖腺嵌合；携带者检测针对母系女性亲属（裂隙灯晶状体检查和定点基因检测），健康的未成年人一般不做携带者检测；再次怀孕时的产前或胚胎植入前检测；非指导性咨询。不提前给出决策答案或结局，不补充没有记录的结果。
knowledge.en: Clinical genetics consultant who interprets only results the learner has already read. Before the genetic report, discusses only what an SMN1 test can and cannot exclude (the common SMN1-deletion form of spinal muscular atrophy) and how to choose a genetic test from the phenotype (AAP 2025 clinical report), with consent. Once the learner has read the genetic report, can explain X-linked inheritance and hemizygosity in a boy; the current HGNC symbol for the legacy gene name the report uses, and HGVS notation (c. and p., the reference transcript); how a nonsense variant is classified under ACMG/AMP 2015 (PVS1) with supporting evidence, and how ‘20 control chromosomes’ differs from today's population databases; what a maternal blood test can and cannot show, and germline mosaicism; carrier testing for female relatives on the mother's side (slit-lamp lens examination and targeted testing), with carrier testing usually not offered to healthy minors; prenatal or pre-implantation testing in a future pregnancy; non-directive counselling. Never gives a decision's answer or the outcome early and adds no result the case does not record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：先天性白内障、婴儿低张力和近端肾小管病——Lowe综合征
title.en: Debrief: congenital cataract, infantile hypotonia and a proximal tubulopathy — Lowe syndrome

conclusion.zh-CN: 11月龄男婴，第二胎第二产，41周顺产，无窒息、产伤和抢救史；3个月时眼睛不追光物，诊断先天性白内障和青光眼并手术。11个月仍抬头不稳、不能独坐，反应迟钝，四肢松软，腱反射引不出。血气pH 7.271、HCO₃⁻ 17.9 mmol/L、BE −8.4 mmol/L，同时尿pH 7.0，尿蛋白0.86 g/24 h，尿β2微球蛋白 > 500 µg/L，广泛性氨基酸尿；血红蛋白70 g/L；SMN1和脑电图正常；听觉诱发电位潜伏期延长、部分听阈异常。OCRL1（OCRL）第15外显子c.1528C>T无义变异，母亲外周血未检出，报告诊断为Lowe综合征；本病例没有记录治疗和随访。今天的做法：SMN1与血气、电解质、尿液检查同步送；先测钾，再分次口服碱剂，不静推碳酸氢钠、不用激素；遗传咨询讲清生殖腺嵌合的残余风险；终身随访眼压、听力（JCIH 2019）、肾脏和发育，并另查贫血原因。
conclusion.en: An 11-month-old boy, his mother's second pregnancy and second birth, born vaginally at 41 weeks without asphyxia, birth injury or resuscitation, had congenital cataracts and glaucoma diagnosed and operated on after his eyes failed to follow light or objects at 3 months. At 11 months he could not hold his head steady or sit, was slow to respond and floppy, with unelicitable reflexes. Blood gas pH 7.271, bicarbonate 17.9 mmol/L, base excess −8.4 mmol/L, with urine pH 7.0, protein 0.86 g/24 h, β2-microglobulin > 500 µg/L and generalised aminoaciduria; haemoglobin 70 g/L; SMN1 and EEG normal; auditory evoked potentials with prolonged latencies and partly abnormal hearing thresholds. A nonsense variant in exon 15 of OCRL1 (OCRL), c.1528C>T, absent from his mother's blood, gave the report's diagnosis of Lowe syndrome; no treatment or follow-up is recorded. Today: SMN1 alongside gas, electrolytes and urine; potassium first, then divided oral alkali, with no IV bicarbonate or steroids; counselling on germline mosaicism; lifelong eye, hearing, kidney and developmental follow-up; a separate anaemia work-up.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 先天性白内障加婴儿期低张力，不能只用“脑性运动落后”或单纯的神经肌肉病解释——这个组合本身就提示要去看肾脏。
keyReasoning.en: Congenital cataract with infantile hypotonia is not explained by ‘cerebral motor delay’ or a neuromuscular disease alone — the combination itself is the cue to look at the kidneys.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 腱反射引不出让人想到前角细胞病，所以要查SMN1；但反应迟钝、眼病和肾小管异常都不在脊髓性肌萎缩的范围内，SMN1正常以后它也不再被支持。
keyReasoning.en: Unelicitable reflexes point towards anterior horn cell disease, so SMN1 is tested; but slow responses, the eyes and the tubular findings lie outside spinal muscular atrophy, and a normal SMN1 result leaves it unsupported.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血液酸中毒（pH 7.271，HCO₃⁻ 17.9 mmol/L）时尿pH仍为7.0，说明肾脏没有排酸或在丢碳酸氢根；尿β2微球蛋白 > 500 µg/L和广泛性氨基酸尿把问题定位在近端小管。没有血钠和血氯，阴离子间隙无法计算。
keyReasoning.en: Acidaemia (pH 7.271, bicarbonate 17.9 mmol/L) with a urine pH still at 7.0 means the kidney is not excreting acid or is losing bicarbonate; β2-microglobulin above 500 µg/L and generalised aminoaciduria place the problem in the proximal tubule. Without sodium and chloride the anion gap cannot be calculated.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 纠正酸中毒不等基因结果，但要先知道血钾：范科尼型病变失钾，碱化又会让血钾继续下降。
keyReasoning.en: Correcting the acidosis does not wait for the genetic result, but it does wait for the potassium: Fanconi-type disease wastes potassium, and alkali pushes it lower still.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 母亲外周血没有查到变异，只能说明她很可能不是杂合携带者，不能排除卵细胞里带有变异；风险既不是50%，也不是零。
keyReasoning.en: Not finding the variant in the mother's blood means she is probably not a heterozygous carrier; it cannot rule out the variant in her egg cells — the risk is neither 50 % nor zero.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 不是所有异常都属于同一个综合征：70 g/L的血红蛋白和异常的听觉诱发电位都需要各自的评估和处理。
keyReasoning.en: Not every abnormality belongs to the syndrome: a haemoglobin of 70 g/L and abnormal auditory evoked potentials each need their own work-up and treatment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 识别：Lowe综合征的三联征是先天性白内障（约半数患儿伴青光眼）、婴儿期低张力伴腱反射消失和近端肾小管病（GeneReviews：Lowe综合征，2019年更新）。本例3个月时眼睛不追光物，诊断先天性白内障和青光眼并手术；11个月抬头不稳、不能独坐，四肢松软，腱反射引不出。腱反射消失时要查SMN1（2018年国际脊髓性肌萎缩诊疗共识）——本例未见异常；但只有同时查血气和尿液，才能发现第三个系统，按表型安排检查（AAP 2025）正要求两者兼顾。
teachingPoints.en: Recognition: Lowe syndrome's triad is congenital cataract (glaucoma in about half of affected boys), infantile hypotonia with absent reflexes and a proximal tubulopathy (GeneReviews: Lowe syndrome, 2019 update). Here: eyes not following light or objects at 3 months, congenital cataracts and glaucoma operated on; at 11 months unsteady head control, unable to sit, floppy limbs and unelicitable reflexes. Absent reflexes call for SMN1 testing (international SMA care consensus, 2018) — no abnormality here — but only the blood gas and the urine reveal the third system, and a phenotype-led work-up (AAP 2025) asks for both.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 定位：血液酸中毒时尿pH > 5.5，说明肾脏没有正常酸化尿液——远端酸化障碍，或近端碳酸氢根阈值降低、超过阈值就丢失；β2微球蛋白升高和广泛性氨基酸尿说明近端小管功能障碍——远端肾小管酸中毒时它们主要见于酸中毒严重、未经治疗的婴儿，补碱后消退（ERKNet/ESPN 2021），所以血碳酸氢根17.9 mmol/L、又有眼病的他更符合原发的近端肾小管病。本例尿pH 7.0、β2微球蛋白 > 500 µg/L、广泛性氨基酸尿；0.86 g/24 h的尿蛋白是肾小管性的，诊断肾病综合征还需要血清白蛋白 < 30 g/L（IPNA 2022）。本病例没有记录电解质、血磷、血钙、尿糖和肌酐，今天它们是确认范科尼型病变和开始治疗的必查项目。
teachingPoints.en: Localisation: a urine pH above 5.5 during acidaemia means the kidney is not acidifying the urine — a distal acidification defect, or bicarbonate wasting above a lowered proximal threshold; raised β2-microglobulin and generalised aminoaciduria mark proximal tubular dysfunction — in distal RTA they appear mainly in untreated infants with severe acidosis and settle on alkali (ERKNet/ESPN 2021), so with a bicarbonate of 17.9 mmol/L and his eyes a primary proximal tubulopathy fits better. Here: urine pH 7.0, β2-microglobulin > 500 µg/L, generalised aminoaciduria; the 0.86 g/24 h of protein is tubular, and nephrotic syndrome would need a serum albumin below 30 g/L (IPNA 2022). This case records no electrolytes, phosphate, calcium, urine glucose or creatinine — today they are needed to confirm a Fanconi-type picture and to start treatment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 治疗：慢性肾小管性酸中毒用口服碱剂（枸橼酸盐或碳酸氢钠），给药尽量频繁——婴儿随每次喂奶少量给，年长儿每日3–4次——按血碳酸氢根调整到正常，这是ERKNet/ESPN 2021为远端肾小管酸中毒规定的做法；近端丢失时所需剂量是远端肾小管酸中毒的数倍。先测血钾——范科尼型病变常还需要补钾、补磷和骨化三醇（GeneReviews：Lowe综合征，2019年更新）。静脉推注碳酸氢钠不适合pH 7.271的慢性酸中毒，还有诱发低钾、低钙的风险。本病例没有记录当年给过任何治疗。
teachingPoints.en: Treatment: a chronic tubular acidosis is treated with oral alkali (citrate or bicarbonate) given as often as possible — in an infant, small amounts with his feeds; three or four times a day in older children — and titrated to a normal plasma bicarbonate, as the ERKNet/ESPN 2021 practice points set out for distal RTA; proximal wasting needs several times the distal-RTA dose. Potassium is measured first, and a Fanconi-type tubulopathy often needs potassium, phosphate and calcitriol as well (GeneReviews: Lowe syndrome, 2019 update). An IV bicarbonate bolus has no place in a chronic acidosis at pH 7.271 and risks hypokalaemia and hypocalcaemia. This case does not record any treatment given at the time.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 遗传：OCRL（旧称OCRL1）位于X染色体，男孩为半合子。c.1528C>T这样的无义变异预示提前出现终止密码子，在以功能丧失致病的基因中按ACMG/AMP 2015属于非常强的致病证据（PVS1）；“20条对照染色体未检出”是2012年的做法，今天用大型人群数据库判断频率。母亲外周血阴性提示她很可能不是携带者，但生殖腺嵌合仍可导致再发：提供遗传咨询、母亲裂隙灯检查，以及再次怀孕时的产前或胚胎植入前检测（GeneReviews：Lowe综合征，2019年更新）。
teachingPoints.en: Genetics: OCRL (legacy name OCRL1) lies on the X chromosome, so a boy is hemizygous. A nonsense change such as c.1528C>T predicts a premature stop codon and, in a gene where loss of function causes disease, is very strong pathogenic evidence under ACMG/AMP 2015 (PVS1); ‘absent from 20 control chromosomes’ is 2012 practice — today large population databases judge frequency. A negative maternal blood test makes her probably not a carrier, but germline mosaicism can still cause recurrence: offer counselling, a maternal slit-lamp examination and prenatal or pre-implantation testing in a future pregnancy (GeneReviews: Lowe syndrome, 2019 update).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 随访：儿童白内障术后和Lowe综合征本身都有青光眼风险，要终身测眼压，并做屈光矫正和弱视治疗；听觉诱发电位异常时，按JCIH 2019应立即做诊断性听力评估并尽早助听（“1-3-6”原则：1个月筛查、3个月确诊、6个月干预，而他已经11个月）；肾脏科终身监测酸碱、电解质、骨骼和肾功能——Lowe综合征的肾功能会随年龄下降（GeneReviews，2019年更新）。
teachingPoints.en: Surveillance: childhood cataract surgery and Lowe syndrome itself both carry a glaucoma risk, so eye pressure is checked for life, with optical correction and amblyopia care; with abnormal auditory evoked potentials, JCIH 2019 asks for diagnostic audiology now and early amplification (its 1-3-6 benchmarks — screening by 1 month, diagnosis by 3, intervention by 6 — are long past at 11 months); nephrology monitors acid–base, electrolytes, bone and kidney function for life, as kidney function in Lowe syndrome declines with age (GeneReviews, 2019 update).

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是2012年发表的单例报告；按本病例的记录，病程止于基因诊断，不能用来比较治疗或判断预后。病例事实沿用1.0.0版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对；本病例没有记录当年的任何治疗、生命体征、电解质和随访结局，也不模拟任何生理变化。决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点是依据现行指南的教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report published in 2012; as recorded in this case, the course ends at the genetic diagnosis, so it cannot compare treatments or set a prognosis. The case facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article; this case records no treatment, vital signs, electrolytes or follow-up outcome, and no physiology is simulated. The decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design based on current guidance and do not change the published course.

unknowns.en: The parents' health and consanguinity, similar illness among maternal relatives; the mother's lens examination and any assessment of germline mosaicism.

unknowns.en: The variant's reference transcript and protein-level name; any treatment, the discharge and the follow-up outcome (kidney function, vision, hearing, development).
